invariants.rationale: The method returns the result of a function call, and typically factories should not return null to avoid NullPointerExceptions.
The method requires metaClient as a parameter; it is likely assumed to be non-null.
By the method signature and its return statement, result should be an instance of ReaderContextFactory.
Generics are erased at runtime, but result must still be a ReaderContextFactory of some type.
